## Methods


### _Platynereis dumerilii_ husbandry 
_P.dumerilii_ cultures were maintained in filtered artificial seawater (FASW) at 18°C by Emily Savage. For spawning, mature adults were transferred pairwise into beakers, where the larvae were subsequently incubated at 18°C. 

### Treatment with Cryopreservation Agents 
Prior to freezing, larvae were treated with a cryoprotectant solution containing 5% DMSO and 0.1% sucrose in FASW. Larvae were incubated for at least 1 h before being transferred into carriers, microcapillary tubes or Eppendorf tubes for freezing.

# Results

```{r temp-plot, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

temp_data <- read_excel("data/quantification_AFS_slope.xlsx", sheet = "run1+run2")

temp_data <- temp_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    afs_sd = sd(c(AFS_temp_run1, AFS_temp_run2)),
    measured_sd = sd(c(measured_temp_1_run1, measured_temp_2_run1, measured_temp_1_run2, measured_temp_2_run2))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

sd_afs <- round(mean(temp_data$afs_sd, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
sd_measured <- round(mean(temp_data$measured_sd, na.rm = TRUE), 2)

temp_long <- pivot_longer(
  temp_data,
  cols = c(AFS_temp_mean, measured_temp_mean),
  names_to = "device",
  values_to = "temperature"
)

slopes <- temp_long %>%
  group_by(device) %>%
  summarize(slope = coef(lm(temperature ~ `time (min)`))[2])

slope_afs <- round(slopes$slope[slopes$device == "AFS_temp_mean"], 2)
slope_measured <- round(slopes$slope[slopes$device == "measured_temp_mean"], 2)

label_afs <- paste0("AFS Machine (", slope_afs, " °C/min, SD = ", sd_afs, " °C, n=2)")
label_measured <- paste0("Thermometer (", slope_measured, " °C/min, SD = ", sd_measured, " °C, n=4)")

ggplot(temp_long, aes(x = `time (min)`, y = temperature, color = device, linetype = device)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("AFS_temp_mean" = "black", "measured_temp_mean" = "lightblue"),
    labels = c(label_afs, label_measured)
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("AFS_temp_mean" = "dashed", "measured_temp_mean" = "solid"),
    labels = c(label_afs, label_measured)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Time (min)", y = "Temperature (°C)", color = "Device", linetype = "Device") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.title = element_blank())
```
